environment: Linux Chromium; native operations, installed applications and artwork simulated. Not macOS acceptance or publisher availability testing.

checks.name: Cached apps and originals render before delayed native scan or network work finishes
Icon actions remain enabled while originals refresh in the background
Compact single page with no management tabs
Default appearance follows dark macOS preference
System mode tracks a live OS appearance change
Manual dark override is saved and does not follow the OS until System is restored
Light, Dark and System controls work without a settings page
Async source updates preserve existing row and image DOM nodes
Original SVG is converted to PNG rather than redrawn
Unknown products never receive an invented vendor icon
Scanning, source checks and previews never change installed apps
App selection is a compact in-window icon grid, not a new native app window
Donor selection copies the selected preview without opening the donor app
Individual Replace applies exactly the selected custom asset
Individual Restore works from the same row
Original artwork can be selected again after using a custom icon
Cancelling a file choice preserves the previous original icon
Rename presets use the original application name
Custom Unicode display names are accepted and shown in the row
Rename errors stay in the small dialog and Restore name returns the original
Filtered Select all and Replace affect only visible eligible rows
Bulk replacement applies all eligible app selections
Restore all remains a single main-screen action
Exact replacement failure is visible in the affected row and message banner
Network failure preserves usable saved originals without blocking controls
App names are rendered as text, not executable markup
Compact rows fit 720, 800, 940 and 1200px windows without horizontal scrolling
No JavaScript runtime errors in all exercised workflows
